trigger_condition: userId is null at mount (auth not yet resolved)
potential_consequence: AnalyticsDashboard fetch effect fires with all-undefined filters before user is identified

trigger_condition: start_date or end_date URL param is a locale-format string like 'Jan 1 2024'
potential_consequence: Non-ISO dates accepted on some browsers, rejected on others; inconsistent sanitization

trigger_condition: URL has invalid time_period but valid users or projects array
potential_consequence: Sanitized filter state lacks time_period; API query sent without required temporal scope

trigger_condition: localStorage quota exceeded during setFilters call inside handleFilterChange
potential_consequence: URL written but React state remains stale; divergence persists until next React Router navigation
